Cost per pound = $10  
Amount purchased = \(\frac{7}{9}\) pound

\[
\text{Cost} = 10 \times \frac{7}{9} = \frac{70}{9} = 7.777\ldots
\]

The register rounds to the nearest cent, so \(7.777\ldots\) rounds to \(7.78\).

The answer is $7.78.
